structural_breaks.note: Float of the Egyptian pound (≈8.9 → ≈18 EGP/USD): EGP-reported revenue of export/foreign operations roughly doubled by translation; YoY in EGP for 4Q16–3Q17 is dominated by FX. (An earlier step devaluation 7.73→8.85 took place on 14-Mar-2016.)
Acquisitions of PT CG Power Systems Indonesia and Valdius Engineering (Pakistan) — group transformer capacity to ~30,000 MVA/yr; consolidated during 2021.
EGP devaluation (~15.7 → ~18.3 per USD, CBE special MPC); 1Q22 release refers to 'the latest exchange rates' movement'.
CBE moves to a durably flexible exchange-rate regime; EGP ~19.7 → ~24 (and ~30 by Jan-2023). EGP-translated revenue inflates in 2023.
CBE lets the exchange rate be set by market forces (EGP ~30.9 → ~47-50 per USD); 1Q24 release attributes revenue growth mainly to the devaluation.

Segment re-organisation: 'Transformers' is no longer reported alone; new 'Electrical Products' segment = Transformers + Busway + Motion + E-mobility (and 'Other electrical products' moved into Wire, Cable & Accessories). Recast comparatives available only for 2024 (in 2025 releases). revenue_segment switches basis here; YoY stays like-for-like because every FY2025Q1+ point carries the company's recast EP comparative. Transformer MVA volumes continue unchanged (volume_transformers_mva).

profile.products: Integrated energy group: wires & cables (largest), E&C/turnkey (power plants, substations), digital solutions (smart meters), electrical products — distribution & power transformers (oil/dry), busway, motion, e-mobility; infrastructure investments. Transformers segment: ~1,100–1,600 MVA/quarter in 2016 rising to ~6,100–6,200 MVA/quarter in 4Q25/2Q26; transformers backlog EGP 34.5bn at 30-Jun-2026.

profile.end_markets: Egypt & MENA utilities and national grid projects, Sub-Saharan Africa, GCC, Southeast Asia/Australia (via Indonesia), EU/US exports (hypothesis). Transformers were ~4–5% of group revenue (2016–2024); Electrical Products 7.0% of Q2-2026 revenue.

proxy_routes.why: Egyptian exports of >10 MVA liquid transformers — Elsewedy is the dominant Egyptian transformer exporter
Egyptian exports of 650 kVA–10 MVA transformers (Elsewedy/Egytrafo)
Egyptian exports of ≤650 kVA distribution transformers
Egypt→US large transformers (tests whether the US shortage pulled Egyptian units)
CBE USD/EGP monthly average — EGP revenue is dominated by translation after 2016/2022/2024 devaluations; needed as a control, not as a demand proxy
Indonesian transformer exports (CG Power Systems Indonesia) — BPS/Comtrade, not in the current exporter list

gaps: revenue_segment: Transformers-only revenue is not published after FY2024Q4 (segment folded into 'Electrical Products'); FY2025Q1+ points are Electrical Products (basis marked per point).
volume_transformers_mva/revenue_segment: no FY2015 history collected (comparatives only).
collection_notes: revenue_total: 'Revenue' row of the summary income statement in each quarterly earnings release (EGP 000 → EGP million), quarter column; prior_year_comparative = same row prior-year quarter column. The 2Q25 release prints H1 before Q2 — handled.

revenue_segment FY2016Q1–FY2024Q3: 'Transformers' row (Sales) of the company's 'Segment Analysis' IR analyst-pack file for the same quarter (PDF 2016–2021, xlsx 2022Q4+); identical to the ER 'Transformers Segment – Revenues After Intercompany Sales' figure (checked e.g. Q1-2019 431,836 k). FY2016Q3/FY2017Q3 = 9M block minus H1 block (only YTD printed). FY2022Q1–Q3: the 1Q/2Q/3Q-2022 PDFs are images without text, so the quarter blocks re-printed in the FY2022 xlsx are used. FY2024Q4 from the 4Q24 ER Transformers table (FY2024 file prints FY only). Units detected by comparing each file's Total with ER revenue.

revenue_segment FY2025Q1+: 'Electrical Products (Transformers, Busway, Motion and E-mobility) — Revenues After Intercompany Sales' table in the ER; comparatives are the company's recast prior-year EP figures (e.g. Q2-2025 printed as 4,209.0m in the 2Q25 ER but 4,497.5m as comparative in the 2Q26 ER).
All values in nominal EGP — no FX conversion (per contract). Use YoY from comparatives; interpret with the devaluation breaks. The MVA series is FX-free and useful as a robustness target.
Source site: ir.elsewedyelectric.com results center (files on irfiles.technologyverse.com/swdy2/, the IR host used by the company).
